# Simulation of unified forecasting


```{r unified-simulation, eval=FALSE}
grid_pipeline <- data.frame(
  T = 1000,
  d = 0.6,
  p = 1L,
  q = 0L,
  ar_strength = 0.5,
  ma_strength = 0.5
)

grid_pipeline <- expand.grid(
  T = c(500, 1000),
  d = c(0.4, 0.8, 1.2),
  ar_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  ma_strength = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
  model = c("1_0", "0_1", "1_1", "2_0")
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 1L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 0L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 2L
    ),
    q = dplyr::case_when(
      model == "1_0" ~ 0L,
      model == "0_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "1_1" ~ 1L,
      model == "2_0" ~ 0L
    ),
    ar_strength = dplyr::if_else(p == 0, 0, ar_strength),
    ma_strength = dplyr::if_else(q == 0, 0, ma_strength)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct() %>%
  dplyr::select(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(T, d, p, q, ar_strength, ma_strength)


future::plan(
  future::multisession,
  workers = 10
)

progressr::handlers("progress")
```

## Analysis 

```{r}
future::plan(future::sequential)
unified_forecast_res = readRDS("pipeline_forecast_summary.rds")
unified_forecast_res_add = readRDS("pipeline_forecast_summary_additional.rds")

append_one_component <- function(df_main, df_add) {
  if (is.null(df_main))
    return(df_add)
  if (is.null(df_add))
    return(df_main)
  
  if (!is.data.frame(df_main) || !is.data.frame(df_add)) {
    stop("Both objects must be data frames / tibbles.")
  }
  
  df_add_new <- df_add
  
  if ("scenario_id" %in% names(df_main) &&
      "scenario_id" %in% names(df_add)) {
    max_id <- max(df_main$scenario_id, na.rm = TRUE)
    df_add_new <- df_add_new %>%
      mutate(scenario_id = scenario_id + max_id)
  }
  
  bind_rows(df_main, df_add_new)
}

combine_forecast_results <- function(res_main, res_add) {
  all_names <- union(names(res_main), names(res_add))
  
  out <- vector("list", length(all_names))
  names(out) <- all_names
  
  for (nm in all_names) {
    out[[nm]] <- append_one_component(df_main = res_main[[nm]], df_add  = res_add[[nm]])
  }
  
  out
}

unified_forecast_res <- combine_forecast_results(unified_forecast_res, unified_forecast_res_add)
rm(unified_forecast_res_add)
invisible(gc())
unified_wis <- make_wis_summary(unified_forecast_res)
```

### Estimation of d

```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 18
legend_text_size <- 16
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6

panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

clean_d_summary <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of("order_selection_method")) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model_label = dplyr::case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      
      MSE_d = RMSE_d^2
    )
}

make_d_est_plot_data_singleT <- function(df, T_show, balanced_farma = TRUE) {
  df_use <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(T_value == T_show,
                  model %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)", "(0,1)", "(1,1)"))
  
  if (balanced_farma) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      dplyr::filter(model != "(1,1)" |
                      abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10)
  }
  
  df_use %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      strength_value = dplyr::case_when(
        model %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)") ~ ar_strength,
        model == "(0,1)" ~ ma_strength,
        model == "(1,1)" ~ ar_strength
      ),
      
      strength_factor = factor(
        strength_value,
        levels = c(0.2, 0.5, 0.8),
        labels = c("0.2", "0.5", "0.8")
      ),
      
      model_label = factor(
        model_label,
        levels = c(
          "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
          "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
          "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
          "FARFIMA(1,d,1)"
        )
      )
    )
}

plot_d_est_metric_singleT <- function(df,
                                      metric_col,
                                      y_lab,
                                      add_zero_line = FALSE,
                                      show_x_lab = TRUE,
                                      show_legend = TRUE,
                                      show_strips = TRUE,
                                      plot_title = NULL) {
  strength_cols <- c(
    "0.2" = "#1B9E77",
    "0.5" = "#D95F02",
    "0.8" = "#7570B3"
  )
  
  g <- ggplot(df,
              aes(
                x = d_true,
                y = .data[[metric_col]],
                colour = strength_factor,
                group = strength_factor
              )) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    facet_wrap(~ model_label, nrow = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df$d_true)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = strength_cols, drop = FALSE) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = if (show_x_lab) {
        "True memory parameter d"
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      y = y_lab,
      colour = "Dependence strength"
    ) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = legend_line_width, size = legend_point_size)
    )) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) {
        "top"
      } else {
        "none"
      },
      
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      
      legend.title = element_text(size = legend_title_size, face = "bold"),
      
      legend.text = element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      
      legend.key.width = unit(1.8, "lines"),
      
      legend.spacing.x = unit(0.5, "lines"),
      
      strip.background = if (show_strips) {
        element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black")
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      
      strip.text = if (show_strips) {
        element_text(size = strip_text_size)
      } else {
        element_blank()
      },
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size,
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = shared_label_size),
      
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = shared_label_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (add_zero_line) {
    g <- g +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        colour = "black",
        linetype = "dashed",
        linewidth = reference_line_width
      )
  }
  
  g
}

plot_d_estimation_two_panel_singleT <- function(df,
                                                T_show,
                                                file_name = NULL,
                                                width = 16,
                                                height = 10) {
  df_plot <- make_d_est_plot_data_singleT(df = df,
                                          T_show = T_show,
                                          balanced_farma = TRUE)
  
  p_bias <- plot_d_est_metric_singleT(
    df = df_plot,
    metric_col = "mean_d_bias",
    y_lab = "Mean bias",
    add_zero_line = TRUE,
    show_x_lab = FALSE,
    show_legend = TRUE,
    show_strips = TRUE,
    plot_title = NULL
  )
  
  p_mse <- plot_d_est_metric_singleT(
    df = df_plot,
    metric_col = "MSE_d",
    y_lab = "MSE",
    add_zero_line = FALSE,
    show_x_lab = FALSE,
    show_legend = FALSE,
    show_strips = FALSE,
    plot_title = NULL
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_bias,
    p_mse,
    ncol = 1,
    align = "v",
    axis = "lr",
    rel_heights = c(1, 1)
  )
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0,
      y = 0.075,
      width = 1,
      height = 0.925
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("True memory parameter d",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.018,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}

d_est_summary_clean <- clean_d_summary(unified_forecast_res$d_summary)

p_d_T500 <- plot_d_estimation_two_panel_singleT(
  df = d_est_summary_clean,
  T_show = 500,
  file_name = file.path(shiny_unified_plot_dir, "unified_d_estimation_T500.pdf"),
  width = 16,
  height = 14
)

p_d_T1000 <- plot_d_estimation_two_panel_singleT(
  df = d_est_summary_clean,
  T_show = 1000,
  file_name = file.path(unified_plot_dir, "unified_d_estimation_T1000.pdf"),
  width = 16,
  height = 14
)
```

### Order selection accuracy

```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30
legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

method_cols_order <- paper_method_colours[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

method_ltys_order <- paper_method_linetypes[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

method_shapes_order <- paper_method_shapes[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

make_order_accuracy_plot_data <- function(df, metric_col = "order_accuracy") {
  if (!metric_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(paste("Cannot find metric column:", metric_col))
  }
  
  df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(n),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(2,0)", "(0,1)", "(1,1)")),
      
      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ as.character(model)
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(paste0("psi==", ar_strength), levels = paste0("psi==", sort(
        unique(ar_strength)
      ))),
      
      nu_label = factor(paste0("nu==", ma_strength), levels = paste0("nu==", sort(
        unique(ma_strength)
      ))),
      
      method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ order_selection_method
      ),
      
      method = factor(method, levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
      
      accuracy_value = .data[[metric_col]]
    )
}

make_order_method_legend <- function() {
  make_method_legend(
    methods = c("Functional IC", "CV"),
    title = "Order selection",
    base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt,
    point_size = legend_point_size,
    line_width = legend_line_width
  )
}

plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d <- function(df,
                                               model_show,
                                               T_show,
                                               title = NULL,
                                               y_limits = c(0, 1.02)) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show, T_value == T_show)
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show, "and T =", T_show))
  }
  
  model_clean <- gsub("[() ]", "", model_show)
  
  pq <- strsplit(model_clean, ",")[[1]]
  
  p0 <- as.integer(pq[1])
  q0 <- as.integer(pq[2])
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = d_true,
      y = accuracy_value,
      group = method,
      colour = method,
      linetype = method,
      shape = method
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_order, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = y_limits,
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.03))
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$d_true)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45,
        hjust = 1,
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (p0 > 0 && q0 == 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 == 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(. ~ nu_label, labeller = label_parsed)
    
  } else if (p0 > 0 && q0 > 0) {
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(nu_label ~ psi_label, labeller = label_parsed)
  }
  
  g
}

combine_four_order_accuracy_fixedT <- function(df,
                                               T_show,
                                               file_name = NULL,
                                               width = 16,
                                               height = 12,
                                               y_limits = c(0, 1.02)) {
  legend <- make_order_method_legend()
  
  p1 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,0)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(2,0)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(0,1)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_order_accuracy_one_model_by_d(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,1)",
    T_show = T_show,
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(p1,
                                  p2,
                                  p3,
                                  p4,
                                  ncol = 2,
                                  align = "hv",
                                  axis = "tblr")
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Selection accuracy",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label("True memory parameter d",
                        x = 0.53,
                        y = 0.022,
                        size = shared_label_size)
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots of RMSE ratio


```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

method_cols_unified <- paper_method_colours[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

method_ltys_unified <- paper_method_linetypes[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

method_shapes_unified <- paper_method_shapes[c("Functional IC", "CV")]

make_unified_balanced_ratio_summary <- function(df,
                                                window_show = "expanding",
                                                T_show = 1000) {
  T_name <- if ("T" %in% names(df)) {
    "T"
  } else if ("n" %in% names(df)) {
    "n"
  } else {
    stop("Need `T` or `n` column.")
  }
  
  df_use <- df %>%
    mutate(
      T_value = as.numeric(.data[[T_name]]),
      d_true = as.numeric(d_true),
      h = as.numeric(h),
      p_true = as.integer(p_true),
      q_true = as.integer(q_true),
      ar_strength = as.numeric(ar_strength),
      ma_strength = as.numeric(ma_strength),
      
      window_type = case_when(
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
        
        str_detect(tolower(as.character(window_type)), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
        
        TRUE ~ as.character(window_type)
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ as.character(order_selection_method)
      ),
      
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")")
    )
  
  if (!"RMSE_ratio" %in% names(df_use)) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      mutate(RMSE_ratio = RMSE_farma / RMSE_far)
  }
  
  window_show_clean <- case_when(
    str_detect(tolower(window_show), "exp") ~ "Expanding",
    
    str_detect(tolower(window_show), "fix") ~ "Fixed",
    
    TRUE ~ window_show
  )
  
  df_use <- df_use %>%
    filter(
      window_type == window_show_clean,
      T_value == T_show,
      model %in% c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
    ) %>%
    filter((p_true > 0 & q_true == 0) |
             (p_true == 0 & q_true > 0) |
             (p_true > 0 &
                q_true > 0 &
                abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10)) %>%
    mutate(
      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
        TRUE ~ model
      ),
      
      d_label = paste0("d==", d_true),
      
      strength_value = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ ar_strength,
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ ma_strength,
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ ar_strength,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      ),
      
      strength_label = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("psi~'='~nu~'='~", ar_strength),
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = factor(order_selection_method, levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")),
      
      model = factor(model, levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)"))
    )
  
  d_levels <- df_use %>%
    distinct(d_true, d_label) %>%
    arrange(d_true) %>%
    pull(d_label)
  
  strength_levels <- df_use %>%
    distinct(strength_value, strength_label) %>%
    arrange(strength_value) %>%
    pull(strength_label)
  
  df_use %>%
    mutate(
      d_label = factor(d_label, levels = d_levels),
      
      strength_label = factor(strength_label, levels = strength_levels)
    ) %>%
    group_by(
      T_value,
      d_true,
      d_label,
      strength_value,
      strength_label,
      h,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      model,
      model_title,
      order_selection_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      RMSE_ratio = mean(RMSE_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      RMSE_far = mean(RMSE_far, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      RMSE_farma = mean(RMSE_farma, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      n_rep_used = mean(n_rep_used, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

make_unified_method_legend <- function() {
  make_two_method_legend(
    method_cols = method_cols_unified,
    method_linetypes = method_ltys_unified,
    method_shapes = method_shapes_unified,
    title_size = legend_title_size,
    text_size = legend_text_size,
    point_size = legend_point_size,
    line_width = legend_line_width,
    base_size = plot_base_size
  )
}

plot_unified_balanced_one_model <- function(df,
                                            model_show,
                                            title = NULL,
                                            value_col = "RMSE_ratio",
                                            y_limits = NULL) {
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(as.character(model) == model_show)

  if (model_show == "(1,1)" &&
      all(c("ar_strength", "ma_strength") %in% names(df_sub))) {
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      filter(abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10)
  }
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(paste("No data found for model", model_show))
  }
  
  title_use <- if (is.null(title)) unique(df_sub$model_title)[1] else title
  
  if (is.null(y_limits)) {
    y_limits <- ratio_axis_limits(df_sub[[value_col]])
  }
  
  ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = .data[[value_col]],
      group = order_selection_method,
      colour = order_selection_method,
      linetype = order_selection_method,
      shape = order_selection_method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = plot_line_width) +
    geom_point(size = plot_point_size) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = method_cols_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = method_ltys_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = method_shapes_unified, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(df_sub$h)), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.04))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_limits) +
    facet_grid(d_label ~ strength_label, labeller = label_parsed) +
    labs(title = title_use, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = plot_base_size) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = "black"),
      
      strip.text = element_text(size = strip_text_size),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = axis_tick_width),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(3, "pt"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(panel_spacing_size, "lines"),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
}

combine_four_unified_rmse_ratio_models <- function(df,
                                                   file_name = NULL,
                                                   width = 16,
                                                   height = 12,
                                                   common_y = FALSE,
                                                   value_col = "RMSE_ratio",
                                                   y_limits = NULL,
                                                   y_axis_label = "Root mean squared error ratio to FARFIMA(1,1,0)") {
  models <- c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
  titles <- c(
    "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
    "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
    "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
    "FARFIMA(1,d,1)"
  )

  assemble_ratio_panel_grid(
    df = df,
    models = models,
    titles = titles,
    value_col = value_col,
    plot_model = plot_unified_balanced_one_model,
    legend = make_unified_method_legend(),
    y_axis_label = y_axis_label,
    file_name = file_name,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    y_limits = y_limits,
    common_y = common_y,
    shared_label_size = shared_label_size
  )
}
```

```{r}
benchmark_res <- unified_forecast_res$ratio_summary %>%
  filter(n == 1000,
         window_type == "expanding",
         h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
         d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4)) %>%
  select(p_true,
         q_true,
         d_true,
         ar_strength,
         ma_strength,
         h,
         RMSE_far,
         MAE_far) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, h) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = mean(RMSE_far, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE = mean(MAE_far, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = "Benchmark")

plugin_res <- unified_forecast_res$ratio_summary %>%
  filter(n == 1000,
         window_type == "expanding",
         h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
         d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4)) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = case_when(
      order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "IC",
      grepl("^cv", order_selection_method) ~ "CV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Method)) %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, h, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    RMSE = mean(RMSE_farma, na.rm = TRUE),
    MAE = mean(MAE_farma, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

unified_metrics_long <- bind_rows(benchmark_res, plugin_res)

unified_table <- unified_metrics_long %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Benchmark", "IC", "CV"))) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(RMSE, MAE)) %>%
  arrange(p_true, q_true, d_true, h) %>%
  mutate(Model = paste0("$(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")$"))

unified_table <- unified_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    min_RMSE = min(c(RMSE_Benchmark, RMSE_IC, RMSE_CV), na.rm = TRUE),
    min_MAE = min(c(MAE_Benchmark, MAE_IC, MAE_CV), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    RMSE_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(RMSE_Benchmark, min_RMSE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_Benchmark),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_Benchmark)
    ),
    
    RMSE_IC_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(RMSE_IC, min_RMSE)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_IC), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_IC)
    ),
    
    RMSE_CV_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(RMSE_CV, min_RMSE)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_CV), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", RMSE_CV)
    ),
    
    MAE_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(MAE_Benchmark, min_MAE)),
      paste0(
        "\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{",
        sprintf("%.4f", MAE_Benchmark),
        "}}"
      ),
      sprintf("%.4f", MAE_Benchmark)
    ),
    
    MAE_IC_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(MAE_IC, min_MAE)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", MAE_IC), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", MAE_IC)
    ),
    
    MAE_CV_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(MAE_CV, min_MAE)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", MAE_CV), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", MAE_CV)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

d_groups <- unified_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

model_groups <- unified_table %>%

unified_table_print <- unified_table %>%

    RMSE_Benchmark_print,
    RMSE_IC_print,
    RMSE_CV_print,
    MAE_Benchmark_print,
    MAE_IC_print,
    MAE_CV_print
  )
```

### Plots for ECP


```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

benchmark_label <- "FARFIMA(1,1,0)"

method_cols_unified <- paper_method_colours[
  c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Functional IC", "CV")
]

method_ltys_unified <- paper_method_linetypes[
  c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Functional IC", "CV")
]

method_shapes_unified <- paper_method_shapes[
  c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Functional IC", "CV")
]

prepare_unified_ecp_data <- function(df,
                                     alpha_show,
                                     T_show = 1000,
                                     window_show = "expanding") {
  
  df %>%
    filter(
      alpha == alpha_show,
      n == T_show,
      tolower(window_type) == tolower(window_show)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      forecast_method = case_when(
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("far", "far(1)", "benchmark") ~ benchmark_label,
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("farma") &
          order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("farma") &
          order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(forecast_method)) %>%
    group_by(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      alpha,
      h,
      forecast_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      ECP = mean(ECP, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      model = paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
      
      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(1,1)"
        )
      ),

      d_label = factor(
        paste0("d==", d_true),
        levels = paste0(
          "d==",
          sort(unique(d_true))
        )
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi==",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "nu==",
          sort(unique(ma_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      farma_label = factor(
        paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          ar_strength
        ),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      forecast_method = factor(
        forecast_method,
        levels = c(
          benchmark_label,
          "Functional IC",
          "CV"
        )
      )
    )
}

make_unified_forecast_method_legend <- function() {
  make_method_legend(
    methods = c(benchmark_label, "Functional IC", "CV"),
    title = "Forecasting method",
    base_size = legend_text_size * ggplot2::.pt,
    point_size = legend_point_size,
    line_width = legend_line_width
  )
}

plot_unified_ecp_one_model <- function(df,
                                       model_show,
                                       title = NULL,
                                       alpha_show = 0.05,
                                       y_limits = c(0.85, 1.00)) {
  
  df_sub <- df %>%
    filter(
      as.character(model) == model_show
    )
  
  if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      filter(
        abs(ar_strength - ma_strength) < 1e-10
      )
  }
  
  if (nrow(df_sub) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "No data found for model",
        model_show
      )
    )
  }
  
  g <- ggplot(
    df_sub,
    aes(
      x = h,
      y = ECP,
      group = forecast_method,
      colour = forecast_method,
      linetype = forecast_method,
      shape = forecast_method
    )
  ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1 - alpha_show,
      colour = "black",
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = reference_line_width
    ) +
    geom_line(
      linewidth = plot_line_width
    ) +
    geom_point(
      size = plot_point_size
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = method_cols_unified,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = method_ltys_unified,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = method_shapes_unified,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = sort(
        unique(df_sub$h)
      ),
      expand = expansion(
        mult = c(0.02, 0.04)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      ylim = y_limits
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(
      base_size = plot_base_size
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = plot_title_size,
        face = "bold",
        hjust = 0.5
      ),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey95",
        colour = "black"
      ),
      
      strip.text = element_text(
        size = strip_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.text.y = element_text(
        size = axis_text_size
      ),
      
      axis.ticks = element_line(
        linewidth = axis_tick_width
      ),
      
      axis.ticks.length = unit(
        3,
        "pt"
      ),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(
        panel_spacing_size,
        "lines"
      ),
      
      plot.margin = margin(
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size,
        plot_margin_size
      )
    )
  
  if (model_show %in% c("(1,0)", "(2,0)")) {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ psi_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(0,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ nu_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
    
  } else if (model_show == "(1,1)") {
    
    g <- g +
      facet_grid(
        d_label ~ farma_label,
        labeller = label_parsed
      )
  }
  
  g
}

combine_four_unified_ecp_models_shared_axes <- function(
    df,
    alpha_show = 0.05,
    file_name = NULL,
    width = 16,
    height = 12,
    y_limits = c(0.85, 1.00)) {
  
  legend <- make_unified_forecast_method_legend()
  
  p1 <- plot_unified_ecp_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,0)",
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p2 <- plot_unified_ecp_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(0,1)",
    title = "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p3 <- plot_unified_ecp_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(2,0)",
    title = "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  p4 <- plot_unified_ecp_one_model(
    df = df,
    model_show = "(1,1)",
    title = "FARFIMA(1,d,1)",
    alpha_show = alpha_show,
    y_limits = y_limits
  )
  
  main_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p1,
    p2,
    p3,
    p4,
    ncol = 2,
    align = "hv",
    axis = "tblr"
  )
  
  grid_with_shared_labels <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
    cowplot::draw_plot(
      main_grid,
      x = 0.078,
      y = 0.085,
      width = 0.90,
      height = 0.89
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Empirical coverage probability",
      x = 0.020,
      y = 0.53,
      angle = 90,
      size = shared_label_size
    ) +
    cowplot::draw_label(
      "Forecast horizon h",
      x = 0.53,
      y = 0.022,
      size = shared_label_size
    )
  
  final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    legend,
    grid_with_shared_labels,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(0.13, 1)
  )
  
  if (!is.null(file_name)) {
    ggsave(
      filename = file_name,
      plot = final_plot,
      width = width,
      height = height,
      dpi = 1200
    )
  }
  
  final_plot
}
```

### Plots for Score ratio

```{r}
plot_base_size <- 25
plot_title_size <- 28
strip_text_size <- 20
axis_text_size <- 15
shared_label_size <- 30

legend_title_size <- 7.5
legend_text_size <- 7
legend_point_size <- 4.5
legend_line_width <- 1.5

plot_line_width <- 1
plot_point_size <- 2.5
reference_line_width <- 0.8
axis_tick_width <- 0.6
panel_spacing_size <- 0.75
plot_margin_size <- 5

method_cols_score_ratio <- method_cols_unified
method_ltys_score_ratio <- method_ltys_unified
method_shapes_score_ratio <- method_shapes_unified

prepare_unified_score_ratio_data <- function(df,
                                             alpha_show = NULL,
                                             T_show = 1000,
                                             window_show = "expanding",
                                             score_col = "Score") {
  required_cols <- c(
    "n", "d_true", "ar_strength", "ma_strength", "p_true", "q_true",
    "h", "method", "order_selection_method", "window_type", score_col
  )

  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(df))) {
    stop("The score-ratio input is missing required columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (!is.null(alpha_show) && !"alpha" %in% names(df)) {
    stop("The score-ratio input is missing `alpha`.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  df_use <- df %>%
    filter(
      n == T_show,
      tolower(window_type) == tolower(window_show)
    )

  if (!is.null(alpha_show)) {
    df_use <- df_use %>%
      filter(abs(alpha - alpha_show) < 1e-10)
  }

  df_use <- df_use %>%
    mutate(
      forecast_method = case_when(
        tolower(as.character(method)) %in% c("far", "far(1)", "benchmark") ~ "FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
        
        tolower(as.character(method)) == "farma" &
          order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
        
        tolower(as.character(method)) == "farma" &
          order_selection_method == "cv_expanding" ~ "CV",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(forecast_method)) %>%
    group_by(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      h,
      forecast_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      score_value = mean(.data[[score_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = forecast_method,
      values_from = score_value
    )

  required_methods <- c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Functional IC", "CV")

  if (!all(required_methods %in% names(df_use))) {
    stop("Benchmark, Functional IC, or CV scores are missing.", call. = FALSE)
  }
  
  df_use %>%
    mutate(
      score_ratio_adaptive = `Functional IC` / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`,
      score_ratio_cv = CV / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`
    ) %>%
    select(
      n,
      d_true,
      ar_strength,
      ma_strength,
      p_true,
      q_true,
      h,
      score_ratio_adaptive,
      score_ratio_cv
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(
        score_ratio_adaptive,
        score_ratio_cv
      ),
      names_to = "order_selection_method",
      values_to = "score_ratio"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      order_selection_method = case_when(
        order_selection_method == "score_ratio_adaptive" ~ "Functional IC",
        order_selection_method == "score_ratio_cv" ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ order_selection_method
      ),
      
      order_selection_method = factor(
        order_selection_method,
        levels = c(
          "Functional IC",
          "CV"
        )
      ),
      
      model = paste0(
        "(",
        p_true,
        ",",
        q_true,
        ")"
      ),
      
      model = factor(
        model,
        levels = c(
          "(1,0)",
          "(0,1)",
          "(2,0)",
          "(1,1)"
        )
      ),

      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)"
      ),

      strength_label = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("psi~'='~nu~'='~", ar_strength)
      ),
      
      d_label = factor(
        paste0("d==", d_true),
        levels = paste0(
          "d==",
          sort(unique(d_true))
        )
      ),
      
      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi==",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "nu==",
          sort(unique(ma_strength))
        )
      ),
      
      farma_label = factor(
        paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          ar_strength
        ),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      )
    )
}
```

### Plot of weighted interval score ratio

The WIS combines the 80\% and 95\% prediction intervals with the absolute
error of the point forecast. Values below one favour the selected FARFIMA
model over the FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$ benchmark.

```{r}
prepare_unified_wis_ratio_data <- function(df,
                                           T_show = 1000,
                                           window_show = "expanding") {
  required_cols <- c(
    "n", "d_true", "ar_strength", "ma_strength", "p_true", "q_true",
    "h", "method", "order_selection_method", "window_type", "WIS"
  )

  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(df))) {
    stop("Missing required unified WIS columns.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (nrow(df) == 0L || any(!is.finite(df$WIS))) {
    stop("Unified WIS data must be non-empty and finite.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- df %>%
    filter(
      n == T_show,
      tolower(window_type) == tolower(window_show)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      forecast_method = case_when(
        method == "far" ~ "FARFIMA(1,1,0)",
        method == "farma" & order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~
          "Functional IC",
        method == "farma" & grepl("^cv", order_selection_method) ~ "CV",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    )

  if (nrow(out) == 0L || anyNA(out$forecast_method)) {
    stop("Unknown or missing unified WIS method.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    group_by(
      n, d_true, ar_strength, ma_strength, p_true, q_true, h,
      forecast_method
    ) %>%
    summarise(WIS = mean(WIS), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = forecast_method, values_from = WIS)

  required_methods <- c("FARFIMA(1,1,0)", "Functional IC", "CV")

  if (!all(required_methods %in% names(out))) {
    stop("Missing benchmark, Functional IC, or CV WIS.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out <- out %>%
    mutate(
      score_ratio_adaptive = `Functional IC` / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`,
      score_ratio_cv = CV / `FARFIMA(1,1,0)`
    ) %>%
    select(
      n, d_true, ar_strength, ma_strength, p_true, q_true, h,
      score_ratio_adaptive, score_ratio_cv
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(score_ratio_adaptive, score_ratio_cv),
      names_to = "order_selection_method",
      values_to = "score_ratio"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      order_selection_method = recode(
        order_selection_method,
        score_ratio_adaptive = "Functional IC",
        score_ratio_cv = "CV"
      ),
      order_selection_method = factor(
        order_selection_method,
        levels = c("Functional IC", "CV")
      ),
      model = factor(
        paste0("(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")"),
        levels = c("(1,0)", "(0,1)", "(2,0)", "(1,1)")
      ),
      model_title = case_when(
        model == "(1,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,0)",
        model == "(0,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(0,d,1)",
        model == "(2,0)" ~ "FARFIMA(2,d,0)",
        model == "(1,1)" ~ "FARFIMA(1,d,1)"
      ),
      strength_label = case_when(
        p_true > 0 & q_true == 0 ~ paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        p_true == 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        p_true > 0 & q_true > 0 ~ paste0("psi~'='~nu~'='~", ar_strength)
      ),
      d_label = factor(
        paste0("d==", d_true),
        levels = paste0("d==", sort(unique(d_true)))
      ),
      psi_label = factor(
        paste0("psi==", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0("psi==", sort(unique(ar_strength)))
      ),
      nu_label = factor(
        paste0("nu==", ma_strength),
        levels = paste0("nu==", sort(unique(ma_strength)))
      ),
      farma_label = factor(
        paste0("psi~'='~nu~'='~", ar_strength),
        levels = paste0(
          "psi~'='~nu~'='~",
          sort(unique(ar_strength))
        )
      )
    )

  if (any(!is.finite(out$score_ratio)) || anyNA(out$model)) {
    stop("Unified WIS ratios and models must be valid.", call. = FALSE)
  }

  out
}
```

#### Table of interval forecasting scores

```{r}
benchmark_interval <- unified_forecast_res$interval_summary %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    window_type == "expanding",
    h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
    d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4),
    alpha %in% c(0.05, 0.20),
    method == "far"
  ) %>%
  select(
    p_true, q_true, d_true, ar_strength, ma_strength,
    alpha, h, ECP, CPD, Score
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, alpha, h) %>%
  summarise(
    ECP = mean(ECP, na.rm = TRUE),
    CPD = mean(CPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Method = "Benchmark")

plugin_interval <- unified_forecast_res$interval_summary %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    window_type == "expanding",
    h %in% c(1, 5, 10),
    d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4),
    alpha %in% c(0.05, 0.20),
    method == "farma"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = case_when(
      order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "IC",
      grepl("^cv", order_selection_method) ~ "CV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Method)) %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, alpha, h, Method) %>%
  summarise(
    ECP = mean(ECP, na.rm = TRUE),
    CPD = mean(CPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Score = mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interval_table <- bind_rows(benchmark_interval, plugin_interval) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Benchmark", "IC", "CV")),
    CP = case_when(
      alpha == 0.05 ~ "95\\%",
      alpha == 0.20 ~ "80\\%"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(ECP, CPD, Score)) %>%
  arrange(p_true, q_true, d_true, alpha, h) %>%
  mutate(Model = paste0("$(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")$"))

interval_required <- c(
  "ECP_Benchmark", "ECP_IC", "ECP_CV",
  "CPD_Benchmark", "CPD_IC", "CPD_CV",
  "Score_Benchmark", "Score_IC", "Score_CV"
)

if (nrow(interval_table) == 0L ||
    any(!is.finite(as.matrix(interval_table[interval_required])))) {
  stop("Unified interval table data are missing or invalid.", call. = FALSE)
}

interval_table <- interval_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    min_CPD = min(c(CPD_Benchmark, CPD_IC, CPD_CV)),
    min_Score = min(c(Score_Benchmark, Score_IC, Score_CV)),
    ECP_Benchmark_print = sprintf("%.4f", ECP_Benchmark),
    ECP_IC_print = sprintf("%.4f", ECP_IC),
    ECP_CV_print = sprintf("%.4f", ECP_CV),
    CPD_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(CPD_Benchmark, min_CPD)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", CPD_Benchmark), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", CPD_Benchmark)
    ),
    CPD_IC_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(CPD_IC, min_CPD)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", CPD_IC), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", CPD_IC)
    ),
    CPD_CV_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(CPD_CV, min_CPD)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{red}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", CPD_CV), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", CPD_CV)
    ),
    Score_Benchmark_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(Score_Benchmark, min_Score)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", Score_Benchmark), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", Score_Benchmark)
    ),
    Score_IC_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(Score_IC, min_Score)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", Score_IC), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", Score_IC)
    ),
    Score_CV_print = ifelse(
      isTRUE(all.equal(Score_CV, min_Score)),
      paste0("\\textcolor{blue}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", Score_CV), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", Score_CV)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cp_groups <- interval_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true, CP) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

d_groups <- interval_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

model_groups <- interval_table %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

interval_table_print <- interval_table %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  mutate(Model_show = ifelse(row_number() == 1, Model, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true) %>%
  mutate(d_show = ifelse(row_number() == 1, as.character(d_true), "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true, CP) %>%
  mutate(CP_show = ifelse(row_number() == 1, CP, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Model_show, d_show, CP_show, h,
    ECP_Benchmark_print, ECP_IC_print, ECP_CV_print,
    CPD_Benchmark_print, CPD_IC_print, CPD_CV_print,
    Score_Benchmark_print, Score_IC_print, Score_CV_print
  )

names(interval_table_print) <- c(
  "$(p,q)$", "$d$", "CP", "$h$",
  "Bench.", "IC", "CV",
  "Bench.", "IC", "CV",
  "Bench.", "IC", "CV"
)

latex_table <- interval_table_print %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = rep("c", 13),
    caption = paste0(
      "Averaged interval forecasting results for the unified setting ",
      "with $T=1000$ under the expanding-window scheme. ",
      "Results are averaged over the dependence-strength settings. ",
      "The smallest CPD within each setting is highlighted in red, ",
      "and the smallest interval score is highlighted in blue."
    ),
    label = "tab:unified_interval_expanding"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c(" " = 4, "ECP" = 3, "CPD" = 3, "IS" = 3),
    escape = FALSE
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "repeat_header", font_size = 7)

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(cp_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  if (!(cp_groups$end[i] %in% d_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(cp_groups$end[i], extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){3-13}")
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(d_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  if (!(d_groups$end[i] %in% model_groups$end)) {
    latex_table <- latex_table %>%
      row_spec(d_groups$end[i], extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){2-13}")
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(model_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  latex_table <- latex_table %>%
    row_spec(model_groups$end[i], extra_latex_after = "\\midrule")
}

latex_table <- sub(
  "\\begin{longtable}[t]",
  "\\begin{longtable}[c]",
  latex_table,
  fixed = TRUE
)

cat("\\begingroup\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2pt}\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\LTleft}{\\fill}\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\LTright}{\\fill}\n")
cat(latex_table)
cat("\\endgroup\n")
```


#### Table of weighted interval scores

```{r}
benchmark_wis <- unified_wis %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    window_type == "expanding",
    h %in% 1:10,
    d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4),
    method == "far"
  ) %>%
  select(p_true, q_true, d_true, ar_strength, ma_strength, h, WIS) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, h) %>%
  summarise(WIS = mean(WIS), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Method = "FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$")

plugin_wis <- unified_wis %>%
  filter(
    n == 1000,
    window_type == "expanding",
    h %in% 1:10,
    d_true %in% c(0.2, 0.6, 1, 1.4),
    method == "farma"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = case_when(
      order_selection_method == "adaptive_ic" ~ "Functional IC",
      grepl("^cv", order_selection_method) ~ "CV",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Method)) %>%
  group_by(p_true, q_true, d_true, h, Method) %>%
  summarise(WIS = mean(WIS), .groups = "drop")

unified_wis_print <- bind_rows(benchmark_wis, plugin_wis) %>%
  mutate(
    Model = paste0("$(", p_true, ",", q_true, ")$"),
    Method = factor(
      Method,
      levels = c("FARFIMA$(1,1,0)$", "Functional IC", "CV")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(p_true, q_true, Model, d_true, Method, h, WIS)

if (nrow(unified_wis_print) == 0L || any(!is.finite(unified_wis_print$WIS))) {
  stop("Unified WIS table data are missing or invalid.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (anyDuplicated(unified_wis_print[c(
  "p_true", "q_true", "d_true", "Method", "h"
)])) {
  stop("Unified WIS table keys are not unique.", call. = FALSE)
}

unified_wis_print <- unified_wis_print %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true, h) %>%
  mutate(
    min_WIS = min(WIS),
    WIS_print = ifelse(
      round(WIS, 4) == round(min_WIS, 4),
      paste0("\\textcolor{purple}{\\textbf{", sprintf("%.4f", WIS), "}}"),
      sprintf("%.4f", WIS)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Model, d_true, Method, h, WIS_print) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = h, values_from = WIS_print, names_prefix = "h_") %>%
  arrange(Model, d_true, Method)

wis_d_groups <- unified_wis_print %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

wis_model_groups <- unified_wis_print %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  summarise(end = max(row_id), .groups = "drop")

unified_wis_print <- unified_wis_print %>%
  group_by(Model) %>%
  mutate(Model_show = ifelse(row_number() == 1, Model, "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Model, d_true) %>%
  mutate(d_show = ifelse(row_number() == 1, as.character(d_true), "")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Model_show, d_show, Method, all_of(paste0("h_", 1:10)))

names(unified_wis_print) <- c(
  "$(p,q)$", "$d$", "Method", paste0("$", 1:10, "$")
)

wis_latex_table <- unified_wis_print %>%
  kbl(
    format = "latex",
    booktabs = TRUE,
    longtable = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE,
    align = c("c", "c", "l", rep("r", 10)),
    caption = paste0(
      "Weighted interval scores for the unified setting with $T=1000$ ",
      "under the expanding-window scheme. Results are averaged over the ",
      "dependence-strength settings. WIS combines the 80\\% and 95\\% ",
      "prediction intervals. The smallest WIS within each setting and horizon ",
      "is highlighted in purple."
    ),
    label = "tab:unified_wis_expanding"
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 3, "Forecast horizon $h$" = 10), escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = "repeat_header", font_size = 7)

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(wis_d_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  if (!(wis_d_groups$end[i] %in% wis_model_groups$end)) {
    wis_latex_table <- wis_latex_table %>%
      row_spec(wis_d_groups$end[i], extra_latex_after = "\\cmidrule(lr){2-13}")
  }
}

for (i in seq_len(max(nrow(wis_model_groups) - 1L, 0L))) {
  wis_latex_table <- wis_latex_table %>%
    row_spec(wis_model_groups$end[i], extra_latex_after = "\\midrule")
}

wis_latex_table <- sub(
  "\\begin{longtable}[t]",
  "\\begin{longtable}[c]",
  wis_latex_table,
  fixed = TRUE
)

cat("\\begingroup\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{2pt}\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\LTleft}{\\fill}\n")
cat("\\setlength{\\LTright}{\\fill}\n")
cat(wis_latex_table)
cat("\\endgroup\n")
```
